context: Tests whether the agent can formally annotate an existing algorithm with Hoare Triples and verify its total correctness including termination.

checklist.name: Hoare Triples {P}C{Q}
checklist.description: Explicitly uses Hoare triple notation in documentation or comments.

checklist.name: Precondition P defined
checklist.description: Correctly identifies the starting state required for GCD (e.g., a, b > 0).

checklist.name: Postcondition Q defined
checklist.description: Correctly defines the final state (result = GCD(a, b)).

checklist.name: Loop Invariant I
checklist.description: Identifies the loop invariant (e.g., GCD(a, b) = GCD(x, y)).

checklist.name: Loop Variant v
checklist.description: Identifies the variant (e.g., x + y) and proves it decreases.

checklist.name: Total Correctness proof
checklist.description: Explicitly addresses both partial correctness and termination.
